Noah (New Hire): hi team, first-week question. I'm running a demo tomorrow and my basic load test against the hosted API returned a bunch of 429s after ~15 concurrent streams. Which key should I use for demos and is there a fast path to request a short burst?

Ayesha (DevEx): congrats on the new role! for demos we recommend sandbox keys when possible — hosted keys are meant for production. if you need a short hosted burst (live customer demo), we can request a temporary increase from infra.

Noah (New Hire): sandbox ok for streaming + embeddings? I tried sandbox and still saw some 429s during ramp.

Marco (Infra): sandbox supports streaming + embeddings but its token/concurrency buckets are small. also check whether your CI or VPN is sharing an egress IP (this often triggers proxy-level 429s).

Noah (New Hire): how do I quickly check for IP-related throttling?

Marco (Infra): run a direct curl from your laptop (off corp VPN) and compare to CI. Example:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"ping"}'
```
If laptop succeeds and CI returns 429, it's likely an IP bucket.

Ayesha (DevEx): if it's an IP issue, run your demo from a laptop or a small cloud VM with distinct egress. For partner demos we sometimes provision a temporary egress IP or a short hosted burst — open a support ticket in Console > Help > Support > Request quota increase and tag @infra with project id, peak QPS, duration, and streaming vs non-streaming.

Noah (New Hire): thanks — anyone have a recommended retry/backoff pattern? my simple immediate retries overwhelmed things.

Marco (Infra): exponential backoff with jitter is best. avoid tight sync retries; cap total attempts. our SDKs do exponential backoff by default. see https://console.redwood.ai/docs/retries for examples.

Noah (New Hire): i've opened ticket #7710 with demo window and expected QPS. can infra peek?

infra-bot: Support ticket #7710 created by Noah (New Hire) — status: pending review.

Ayesha (DevEx): saw ticket #7710, i'll follow up with infra in the morning. if you need to rehearse tonight, switch to sandbox and throttle concurrency to 2-3 streams. good luck on the demo! :rocket:
